column3: The padouk bar of Fig. 4 ("a wooden bar (Padouk)"), measured as Bar No. 5 is described: freely suspended, noncontact acoustic excitation, laser-vibrometer free decay. Eta is read by us from the figure's plotted parabolic regression, not printed as a number: alpha = 6.11 + 7.62e-6 f^2 (read error bound a0 +-0.5 1/s, a2 +-0.05e-6 s), so eta = a2 / (2 pi^2) by Eq. 19 = 3.86e-7 +-0.03e-7 s, 4.22 times Table I's 9.16e-8 s. The two disagree, we cannot say why, and they may not be the same bar. Gamma_B is Table I's, which the read a0 agrees with.
